book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Yesu kakighendelela kubhaghombela, “Kulyaghila nungubhaghombela, amoo bhandu bhaayimite apa bhatahwegha ng'obhe mbaka paalonda kughubhona Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga paghuhika kwa makakala.”
Yesu kangughalambuka kibhungi
Mbole ya nhano na yimo, Yesu kakighenda papamu na Petili na Yakobu na Yohana mbaka kukitumbi kitandamaho kwa nga bhandu, kakighalambuka kibhungi mu ulongolo ghwabhe.
Mapinda ghake ghaking'anyima ng'anyi, kahone mundu ywoheli ywa kahotola kung'anyihya handa bhula, pannima apa,
bhakibwitukila Eliya na Musa, bhakibha pa ayobhela na Yesu
Petili kakinng'ombela Yesu. “Nhunda, inoghela twenga tutame apa, tuchenge higubi hindatu, kimo kya ghwenga na kimo kingi kya Musa na kingi kangi kya Eliya.”
Petili na ayake bhakimanya ng'obhe kya kughomba kiyaha bhakiyoghopa muno.
Ndo likibwitukila lihundi likibhagubika na lilobhe likiyihwanika kuhuma mu lila lihundi palighomba, “Ayu ndo Mwana ghwangu yununpala munnyihwanile ywombe.”
Kamu paalyungite mehu kunu na kunu bhakimmona ng'obhe mundu ywoheli papamu naywo; ngati nga Yesu ghweka chake.
Paabheghite mukuhelela kuhuma kukitumbi, Yesu kakiakwilikiha, “Nkotoo kunng'ombela mundu ywohele mihalu muyibhonite mbaka Mwana ghwa Mundu pakalonda kuhyuka.”
Bhakilikamula lilaghilo alyo na bhakighombana, “Akwo kuhyuka mana yake ndo niki?”
Bhakinkonya, “Bhuli ahunda bha malaghilo angulongela, Eliya kahiki huti?”
Yesu kakiayanga “Tela, Eliya katalongola huti kutengeleha mihalu hyoha. Bhuli hino yityekwa kukita Mwana ghwa Mundu inogha kambamandike muno na kuyuyuhwa?
Peni nungunng'ombela, Eliya kahika kala nabho antendela bhaghapalite handa muyityekitwe ya kya ywombe.”
Yesu kangunnamiha nhongolo yuna lindilu
Pabhaahikiliti bhala ahundwa bhangi, bhakiabhona bhatindilwa na lumati lukulu lwa bhandu. Na amoo ahunda bha malaghilo bhakighombana na bhombe.
Kamu bhandu bhala paammonite Yesu bhakikangacha munu, bhakintughila annamuhe
Yesu kakiakonya ahundwa bhake, “Mungughombana nabho niki?”
Mundu yumo ywa mulumati kakinnyanga, “Nhunda nunnyegha kwa ghwenga mwana ghwangu kana lindilo lyakantendite kabhe ywa nga kulongela.

Pipipi aywo lindilo pakankwehagha mwana ghwangu, kannghwihagha pahi na kuntenda kahumwe na lihuluhulu munnomo na kuhyagha meno, mbole mmili ghwake ghungukakama. Nikibhayupa ahundwa bhako bhammuhe aywo lindilu peni bhakilepelwa.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mwenga kibheleko kya nga uhyubhalilo nda tama na mwenga mbaka pakiki? Ndabhalimbilila mbaka pakiki? Munnyeghe aywo nhongolo kwa nenga.”
Bhombe bhakinnghegha yula nhongolo Yesu. Kamu lila lindilu pakammonite Yesu kakinkweha kihilika naywo nhongolo kakighwegha pahi kakibingilika na kuhumiha lihuluhulu pa ngulu.
Yesu kakinkonya tate ghwa yula nhongolo “Nnando aghu ghuntandila pakiki?” Naywo kakinnyanga, “Kutandila pa ukakombo ghwake.
Pipipi lindilu aywo likinnghwiha mumwoto na mumachi ngati kankanjaghane yomo, hinu handa ghwa hotola chonde ghutubhonele luhungu ghututange.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ena handa ghwa hyubhalila, mihalo hyoha yahotoleka kwa mundu yunakuhyubhalila.”
Kamu, tate ghwa yula nhongolo kakinlilila Yesu, “Ninguhyubhalila, peni uhyubhalilo ghwangu ukwila ng'obhe, ghundange.”

Yesu pakabhonite lumati lwa bhandu lukinkwemukila papamu kanongola, kakinkwlikiha yula lindilu, kakinng'ombela, “Ghwenga lindilu ghwanga kughomba na kuyihwa, nungughukwilikiha, ghummuke nhongolo ayu na ukotoo kunnyingila kangi.”
Yula lindilu kakikyota kyobho, kakinnghwiha, kakinloghoheya kwa makakala na kakimmuka. Yula nhongolo kakibhegha handa ntumba bhandu bhakilongela “Kahwegha!”
Peni Yesu kakinkamula kibhoko yula kakombo, kakinnyinula naywo kakiyima.
Mbole, Yesu kakiyingila munyumba kati, ahundwa bhake bhakinkonyekeha mwa bhabheghite pa ghweka chabhe, “Bhuli twenga tukihotola ng'obhe kunmuha yula lindilu?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Ndendo ya kya naha kahone kubhuka maha kwa kunnyupa Chapanga na kulikunga.”
Yesu kangulongela kangi ya kya kuhwegha
Yesu na ahundwa bhake bhakibhuka akwo bhakipitila ku Galilaya. Yesu kakilema mundu ywohele kamanye kwa kabheghite.
Kiyaha kakibha mu kuahunda ahundwa bhake. Kakiaghombela, “Mwana ghwa Mundu katakilukwa na kukamuhwa kwa bhandu nabho bhatankoma mbole ya lisiku lya ndatu katahyuka.”
Peni, ahundwa bhake bhakimanya ng'obhe kila kyakaahundite, nabho bhakihyoghopa kunkonya.
Ghani ywakabheghite Nkulu?
Hinu bhakihika ku Kapelinaumu mbole ya kuyingila mu kitutubhi Yesu kakiakonya ahundwa bhake, “Mukighombana kingiki munjila?”
Peni bhene bhakinnyamala, kiyaha panjila pala bhakighombana ya kya ghani ndo nkulu mubhombe.

Yesu kakitama pahi na kakibhakema bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili na kakiaghombela, “Handa mundu ywoheli ywakapala kubhegha kilongohi inogha kabheghe ghwa kundahe dokwa na kabhe ndumitumi ghwa bhoha.”
Mbole kakintola mwana nndokwa kakinnyimiha pakati yabhe, kakinpakata na kakiaghombela,
“Mundu hyowele ywakankemela yumoo, ywa abha bhana adokwa kwa lihina lyangu, kangungemela nenga. Naywo ywaka ngemela nenga kangunkema yula ywakanaghilite.”
Ywa nga kutupingika kabhegha papamu na twenga
Yohana kaking'ombela “Nhunda, tunmona mundu kangubhua mandilo kwa lihina lyako, twenga tukinkanikiha kiyaha ywombe kabha mukimati kyetu ng'obhe.”
Yesu kakighomba, “Mangankanila, kahone ywohele ywakatenda mihabho kwa lihina lyangu mbole kahotole kukambuka lya uhakata kwa nenga.
Kiyaha ywakabhegha tela na twenga kabha mu mbande yatu.
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, ywohele ywakanpegha mwenga nteko ghwa machi gha kunywegha kiyaha mwenga ndo bhandu bha Kilisto kulyaghila kahone kuhobha lilumbo lyake.”
Unyeghelehi ghwa kutenda ulemwa
“Mundu ywohele ywakannyegheleha yumoo ywa adokwa abha bhatenda ulemwa, yingunnoghela mundu aywo kabhopelwe liganga likulu lya kuhyagila muntandala ghwake na kuchumbukihwa mulihibha.

Kibhoko kyakyo pakighunyegheleha ghutende ulemwa ghukilumuhe. Mbaha ghuyingile mu ubhumi kya nga kibhoko kimo chepa kuyingila na mabhoko mabhili na kuchumbukihwa mumwoto ghwa masiku ghoha ghwa nga kuhimika.
Amwo, mahinje ghake anguhwegha ng'obhe na mwoto ghwake ghwa nga kuhimika.

Na kighulu kyako pakighunnyegheleha kutenda ulemwa, ghukilumule, mbaha ghuyingile muulami kya nga kighulu kimo, chepa kuyingihwa na maghulu ghako ghoha mabhili na ghutaghwe mumwoto ghwa masiku ghoha ghwa nga kuhimika.
Amwo, mahinye ghake kahone kuhwegha na mwoto ghwake ghwa nga kuhimika masiku ghoha.

Na liho lyako palighunyegheleha ghutende ulemwa, ghulitupule, mbaha ghuyingile mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga na liho limo ndu chepa kubhegha na meho ghoha mabhili na ghutaghwe mu mwoto ghwa masiku ghoha ghwa nga kuhimika.
Amwo, ‘Mahinye ghake kahone kuhwegha na mwoto ghwake ghwa nga kuhimika.’ ”
“Mana mundu ywohele kaalungwa mwinyo kwa mwoto.”
“Mwinyo ntema ghwa maha peni handa payiluluka, ghwalungihwa na niki?” “Mmeghe na mwinyo mu mwenga, na ntame kwa uhihimilo nkati yenu.”
